title: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.36671v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) process their entire input at every denoising step. Since visual tokens make up 89-97% of this input on the benchmarks we study, most of the decoding computation is spent repeatedly processing the same image. Visual token pruning methods partially relieve this burden by removing part of the visual tokens, but they lose the removed information and still process the remaining image at every step. To measure how often the image is actually needed, we compare LLaDA-V's predictions with and without the image at every decoding step and find that removing the image changes a token being unmasked at only 22.8% of steps on average and at as few as 7.9%. We therefore propose LOWN, a decoding method that decides at every step whether to process the image and how many tokens to unmask. LOWN predicts the masked tokens without the image and processes the image only when this prediction disagrees with the last

translated_abstract: 扩散视觉语言模型在每个去噪步骤都会处理其全部输入。在我们研究的基准测试中，视觉标记占输入的89%-97%，因此大部分解码计算都耗费在重复处理同一张图像上。视觉标记剪枝方法通过移除部分视觉标记在一定程度上缓解了这一负担，但会丢失被移除的信息，且仍需在每一步处理剩余图像。为了衡量图像实际被需要的频率，我们在每个解码步骤比较LLaDA-V在有图像和没有图像情况下的预测，发现移除图像平均只在22.8%的步骤中改变被解码（unmask）的标记，最低甚至仅为7.9%。因此，我们提出LOWN，一种在每个步骤决定是否处理图像以及解码多少标记的解码方法。LOWN在不使用图像的情况下预测被掩码的标记，仅当该预测与上一次的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出LOWN解码方法，在每个解码步骤自适应地决定是否需要处理图像以及解码多少标记，从而避免扩散视觉语言模型中大量冗余的图像重复计算，显著提升解码效率。
